title: A helper never invents an operational fact, entitlement, or capability
summary: An LLM explanation boundary explains an already-derived assessment; it does not create, waive or alter an entitlement, and it does not guess an outcome-relevant fact that is unresolved. When a fact that matters is unknown, the honest result is REVIEW_REQUIRED, not a confident answer. When a credential is absent or rejected, the feature fails closed instead of silently substituting another model or route.
evidence_note: FlyLo legal-effect model: the application derives operational facts such as FLIGHT_CANCELLED and EXTRAORDINARY_CIRCUMSTANCES; if that is unresolved the compensation assessment becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED 'rather than allowing an LLM to guess'. Grok 'cannot create, waive, or alter an entitlement'. GROK_INTEGRATION: production must fail closed if the credential is absent or rejected and 'must not substitute another model silently'.
invariants: The AI layer is an explanation boundary, not a transaction engine.
Rebooking, cancellation, refund and compensation execution remain separate authorised transactional abilities.
No known outcome-relevant state becomes a guess; an unresolved gate becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Credential absent or rejected -> fail closed; no silent substitute model unless an explicitly published policy authorises it.
Do not present a read-only or assessment result as if it had the authority to mutate an entitlement.
